bio.text: Shelley Moore Capito is the U.S. Senator from West Virginia and the first woman to be a U.S. Senator from the state; the senator was re-elected in 2020.

Capito was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives in 2000, serving seven terms representing the 2nd Congressional District, and earlier represented Kanawha County in the West Virginia House of Delegates.
Capito was born November 26, 1953, in Glen Dale, lives in Charleston, and holds degrees from Duke University (B.S.) and the University of Virginia (M.Ed.).
